name: System-True iOS
summary: The app leans on San Francisco type and stock iOS chrome so it feels like part of the phone rather than a skin on top
best_for: internal tools; note and task apps; a team shipping its first iOS app
avoid_for: shops whose identity depends on distinctive visuals; campaign-style launches
signature_moves: title that shrinks into the nav bar on scroll; inset grouped sections; half-height sheet that expands on drag; light haptic when an action lands; SF Symbols at matched weight
risks: Looks like every other app unless brand colour and photography do real work; easy to under-design empty states

name: Floating Glass iOS
summary: Liquid Glass controls hover over full-bleed content and merge into each other as the screen changes (iOS 26 and later)
best_for: travel and photo-led browsing; music or video front ends; lifestyle apps targeting iOS 26 or newer
avoid_for: screens where body text sits on busy imagery; teams that must ship the same look on Android; older iOS support
signature_moves: tab bar that hovers and shrinks on scroll; toolbar buttons that morph into a sheet; corner radii that nest inside the device corners; content running beneath translucent controls
risks: Stacking glass on cards erases hierarchy; text contrast over photos varies; needs fallback for Reduce Transparency and older OS

name: Expressive Material Android
summary: Material 3 Expressive pushes saturated tonal colour and an uneven mix of shapes with springy responses
best_for: Android-first consumer products; apps aimed at teens and young adults
avoid_for: understated luxury; quiet reading or finance tools
signature_moves: icon that morphs between states; big rounded containers; spring settle on press and release; tonal palette generated from a seed colour; expressive type scale
risks: Becomes childish when each control gets a different shape; spring overshoot can feel unserious in errors

name: Magazine Shop
summary: Edge-to-edge photographs and slim tracked labels sit in a tight two-column grid with almost no interface chrome
best_for: clothing; home and interiors; artisan goods
signature_moves: 4:5 portrait photos; serif or grotesque display type; 1px hairlines; parallax on the product hero; slow image fade-in; small-caps or tracked labels with a size floor
risks: Weak photography is exposed; sparse layout hides price and stock cues; image-heavy pages load slowly on weak networks

name: Warm Wool Paper
summary: Cream paper backgrounds and fibre textures meet organic rounded shapes and small hand-drawn marks to give a family-shop warmth
best_for: yarn and craft shops; gift sellers; small family businesses
signature_moves: warm neutrals with one berry or terracotta accent; 20-28pt radii; faint grain; stitch-line dividers; thread loader that sews across; swatch-to-hero cross-fade; spring-back press on yarn swatches
risks: Turns twee or cluttered; grain hurts legibility and performance; a rounded or handwritten display face must cover Vietnamese diacritics fully (check fonts.csv scripts includes vietnamese)

name: Game-Loop Mascot
summary: A friendly character with streaks and rewards drives repeat visits through bouncy feedback and small celebrations
best_for: language and skill learning; workout habits; children; points and rewards schemes
signature_moves: mascot that reacts to results; confetti on milestones; fat buttons with a visible 3D lip; rings that fill with a spring; daily streak flame
risks: Reward fatigue and guilt over broken streaks; large animation files slow startup

name: Loud Type Slabs
summary: Giant headlines and hard-edged flat colour blocks switch screens abruptly with no easing flourish
best_for: streetwear drops; music and events; independent labels
avoid_for: health services; products where trust is the sale
signature_moves: headlines at 48-72pt; hard offset shadows on flat blocks; scrolling marquee strip; screens that cut instantly with a snap
risks: Wears the eye quickly; contrast and reading comfort suffer; motion-sensitive users need a still version

name: Figures First Dark
summary: Large tabular numerals on a calm dark canvas with a single signal colour put balances and charts in front
best_for: budgeting and banking; trading and crypto wallets; metrics dashboards
avoid_for: gift or craft shops; leisure and family products
signature_moves: very large tabular figures that roll on change; inline sparkline beside each amount; light haptic tick when a transfer is confirmed; green and red used only for movement
risks: Cold in tone; screens fill up with numbers fast; colour-only gain and loss fails colour-blind users

name: Night Screening
summary: A near-black interface lets vivid footage and glowing accents lead while backgrounds drift slowly
best_for: video and music streaming; film or game launches; high-end hardware showcases
avoid_for: children products; handmade or cosy brands; outdoor use in bright sun
signature_moves: looping hero clip bleeding to the edges; frosted backdrop behind controls; header and poster fading while scrolling; slow parallax on key art
risks: Gradient banding on OLED panels; glare readability outdoors; only supports one dark mood

name: Soft Pastel Rounded
summary: Pale tinted surfaces and a rounded sans with soft shadows give the app a warm and approachable voice
best_for: skincare and cosmetics; mother and baby; mindfulness; community apps
signature_moves: corner radii between 16 and 24pt; tint blocks kept to one or two per screen; springy squish on tap; rounded line icons with matching stroke
risks: Pale on pale fails contrast checks; every app in the category looks alike

name: Drag and Fling Spatial
summary: Little visible chrome; people move around by swiping and dragging with one shared element carrying across screens
best_for: note-taking and to-do tools; web browsers; camera and capture apps
avoid_for: first-time-user flows; apps where every action must be findable at a glance
signature_moves: cards you pick up and toss; stack of sheets you pull down one by one; motion that follows the finger then releases on a velocity spring; an element that zooms from list to detail
risks: Hidden gestures go unfound without one-time hints; no visible alternative hurts accessibility and switch control

name: Grid Hairline Minimal
summary: A strict grid with a single typeface and thin rules gets its hierarchy purely from size and white space
best_for: photographers and architects showing work; premium goods; long-form reading
signature_moves: 16pt baseline grid; single typeface at three sizes; flush-left text; 1px dividers instead of cards; quiet opacity fades; snap-aligned paging
risks: Feels bare when content is thin; hierarchy collapses if type scale is sloppy

name: Physical Controls Tactile
summary: Soft inner shadows and physical-feeling switches and paper surfaces give controls a real-object weight
best_for: calculators and timers; instruments and audio mixers; hobby and maker utilities
signature_moves: buttons that sink on press; cast shadows from one fixed light source; dials with detent haptics; leather or paper texture on panels; spring on switch toggles
risks: Reads as old-fashioned if textures are heavy; extra layers cost rendering time; low-contrast edges

name: Drifting Mesh Glow
summary: A slowly animated mesh gradient sits behind plain cards and large type to give an atmospheric backdrop
best_for: AI assistants; meditation and sleep; first-run welcome screens
avoid_for: tables and forms; anything needing long reading
signature_moves: backdrop that slowly shifts hue; blurred colour blobs behind plain white cards; big rounded sheet sliding up over the glow; one display weight for headlines
risks: Falls into the purple-to-blue AI cliche; animated gradients drain battery; text over moving colour loses contrast

name: Fresh Basket Quick-Add
summary: Bright produce photography on clean white cards puts price and unit up front and makes adding to the basket one tap
best_for: grocery; meal kits; food delivery; pharmacy
signature_moves: stepper that morphs from the add button; item fly to basket; sticky basket bar with live total; aisle chips; staggered grid fade-in
risks: Photo inconsistency and dense grids get messy; substitution flows add friction

name: Clear Slot Booking
summary: Calm neutral screens with a confident accent guide people through choosing a service and a time with few steps and clear status
best_for: salons; clinics; repair; tutoring; local services
signature_moves: date strip with snap scrolling; slot chips with selection haptic; bottom sheet confirm; success check; progress dots
risks: Looks template-like; long forms stall completion

name: Listing Grid Marketplace
summary: Compact cards and strong filters favour scanning many listings fast with trust marks on every card
signature_moves: sticky filter chips; swipe to save on a card; stretch header with search; quick-look sheet; haptic on save
risks: Visual noise and uneven user photos

name: Maker Story Profile
summary: Shop pages lead with the person behind the goods through workshop photos and short notes before the product grid
best_for: handmade sellers; local food producers; small-batch brands
signature_moves: full-width maker portrait with parallax; pull-note cards; sheet for gift message; swatch zoom on tap
risks: Copy and photos must be real or it feels staged
